title: Irish Phrase for Wedding Card
read: using the go maire sibh one thanks
Lovely choice — it's the one Irish relatives will recognize as properly traditional. Have a great trip!
irish (gaelic) phrase for a wedding card, short. for my cousin niamh and her husband

A few classic, short Irish options:

* **"Comhghairdeas!"** (*koh-GAR-jus*) — "Congratulations!"
* **"Sláinte agus sonas!"** (*SLAWN-cha AH-gus SUN-us*) — "Health and happiness!"
* **"Go maire sibh bhur saol nua!"** (*guh MAR-eh shiv wur SAYL NOO-ah*) — "May you enjoy your new life (together)!" — a traditional wedding wish.
* **"Mo ghrá thú"** — "you are my love"; better from the couple to each other than from a guest.

A nice card line:

> *Comhghairdeas, Niamh & [name]! Go maire sibh bhur saol nua.*
> Wishing you a lifetime of happiness — love, David
